_about: Prompts said or read aloud in the X-batch videos (2026-11-23 links), copied character for character from the faster-whisper transcripts in research/x-batch-implementation-pack-2026-11-22-CLEAN-NEUTRAL.md (main). ASR errors are kept on purpose: these are the transcript's words, not corrected guesses. verify_prompt_quotes.py proves each one is in the transcript. 'role' says what each line is (Atlas review on PR #49: the checker proves a line is verbatim, not that it is a prompt): instruction = words given to a model to act on; eval_input = a test message sent to a bot in an eval; scenario_input = facts fed into a prompt at runtime; illustration = a generic example of the kind of thing you'd type, not a prompt the speaker used.
